title: Rebecca Cott
clean_html:
Rebecca Cott

Preserved Primary Document • cott-r.htm

photo curtesy of John Carter Rebecca Cott was born in Kent County DE on August 24, 1843, the daughter of John D. Cott and his wife, Sarah Ann Dean. On January 11, 1866 she married Cornelius Ridgeway , the son of William Ridgeway and Deborah HANZER. Cornelius was born on March 28, 1843 in DE, possibly Sussex County. See The Ridgeway Family Bible The children of Cornelius Ridgeway and Rebecca Cott were : Laura Ridgeway (Oct. 29, 1866- ) David Ridgeway (July 9, 1868- ) Florence Ann Ridgeway (April 8, 1870 - ) Sarah Catherine Ridgeway (Jan. 17, 1872 - 1938) on Dec. 25, 1888, she married Hopewell Carter Mary E. Ridgeway (April 8, 1874 - Dec. 30, 1874) John Caleb Ridgeway (Jan. 16, 1877- ) married Sarah Elizabeth MOSLEY Harvey N. Ridgeway (Dec. 29, 1879 - ) Lulu May Ridgeway (April 13, 1882 - ) Rebecca Ridgeway (Dec. 24, 1884- ) James Blaine Ridgeway William Edgar Ridgeway Cornelious Ridgeway died in Dinah's Corner, Kent County, DE on March 31, 1918. He was buried at Immanuel Union (Manship) church in Cheswold. Rebecca died on May 15, 1913.
